fact: The RECADDH network says journalists Herminio Silves and Daniel Almeida are accused of qualified disobedience over reports on a death, and demands the cases be dropped.
The RECADDH human-rights network publicly denounced an escalation of judicial prosecutions and intimidation of journalists in Cabo Verde.
